name: demand-letter-generator
description: AI-powered demand letter generator for law firms

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend,ai -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.dev:ai: cd ai-service && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,ai -c green,yellow "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:ai"
scripts.start:ai: cd ai-service && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../ai-service && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend

author: Steno
